symptom: The customer account has unreadable low-contrast areas, weak layout hierarchy and no way to edit profile details.
expected_behavior: Customers can understand the account at a glance, navigate their data and securely edit persistent profile details on desktop and mobile.
environment: VII local release candidate on 2026-11-12, /account and shared account components.

steps: Open app/account/page.tsx and inspect signed-in profile
reproduction.evidence: Profile is a read-only dl, session API exports GET only, and account colors depend on broad inherited styles.

observations.observation: No profile editing form or save action exists.
Account presentation uses isolated static cards and translucent color rules.

hypotheses.mechanism: The account was implemented as a static presentation without a profile mutation/state contract.
hypotheses.prediction: No edit control, PATCH route or client update function will exist.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Search account page, context and session route for edit/PATCH/update behavior.

hypotheses.mechanism: The visible problem is only stale browser cache.
hypotheses.prediction: Source will already contain an edit flow and explicit high-contrast account tokens.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Inspect current candidate source rather than rendered cache.
hypotheses.result: Current source itself lacks editing and explicit state styling.

fix.change: Added a same-origin authenticated session profile update, rebuilt the account as a complete stateful responsive product, added loading/error/edit/save/cancel states and removed false cross-device wording.
fix.evidence: 18 account, auth and autofill tests passed; TypeScript and scoped ESLint passed; production build passed; Playwright/Axe audit passed signed-out and signed-in desktop and 390px mobile views, including validation, save and reload persistence.

regression_checks: Authenticated profile name and phone persist through reload while email and identity remain immutable.
Unauthenticated, cross-origin and invalid profile mutations are rejected.
Signed-out and signed-in account layouts render without horizontal overflow at desktop and 390px mobile widths.
Axe reported no violations in the four audited account states.
Existing account frontend and WhatsApp lead autofill contracts remain green.
remaining_unknowns: The exact public deployment was not changed or tested because this request did not authorize publication.
Favorites and booking history remain local to the device by current product design; only profile name and phone persist in the signed customer session.
authorization_boundary: Local diagnosis and repair; no public deployment.
